page.overview:
Who is Footbianco?

Footbianco is one of the Franky Family's Kairiki Destroyers.

Footbianco is a large, lean man with shoulder-length ash-violet hair and small stubble on his chin. He wears the Franky Family uniform, consisting of a metal lederhosen with a pink star and a pair of specialized goggles, as well as a dark hat and yellow pants.

Like the other Kairiki Destroyers, Footbianco is an abnormally large human, reaching up above the legs of regular-sized giants and towering above the other members of the Franky Family.

In his initial appearance in the anime, Footbianco was incorrectly drawn blond, with a white hat. This was corrected in the Episode of Merry special.
